review_order: Read local authored mathematical source first and independently reconstruct all statements, proof topology and boundaries before inspecting Lean
Then inspect actual current module/formal providers and source-blind decoder reconstruction; compare to source and check proof
Write your own verdict. Do not read publication-candidate classifications, previous review/decoder artifacts, or task summaries
review_questions: Are all public statements matched including empty/zero/rank-deficient/tall/wide cases?
Does source proof justify claims without unstated independence/nonzero premises?
Are every substantive source proof step and genuine formal prerequisite exposed?
Are existence, algorithm, rank, triangularity, uniqueness and quantum/resource conclusions distinguished?
boundary: Local mathematical-contract review only, not whole migration/reader/purification/CI/main approval. Separate new raw-byte cohort, not resigning older evidence.
